verdict: Acxiom's 1:1 holdco merger (2018-09-20) and Nasdaq-to-NYSE move (last Nasdaq day 2018-10-01, RAMP from 2018-10-02) are one continuing security; the library dated the ending 2018-09-30 from the predecessor's Form 25-NSE and left the successor unlinked.

verification.notes: Library date 2018-09-30 (a Sunday) comes from the predecessor's Form 25-NSE of 2018-09-20, which removed the old registrant, not the stock. Form 25 0001193125-18-289670 and 8-K12B 0001193125-18-289748 give the last Nasdaq session as 2018-10-01 with NYSE RAMP from 2018-10-02. Fails rows agree (ACXM to 10-03 under CUSIP 005125109, RAMP from 10-02 under 53815P108, close $48.48). Continuation evidence (same CUSIP, 8-K12B 0001193125-18-279280; no cash) also checks out.
